The tactical correction preserves older-profile coordinates and option ordering while supplying absolute destinations for113. Retained acting-hero evidence now offers `(5,2)` at cost10, executes that discovered command, preserves discovery bytes across restore, and rejects blocked `(6,1)`.

The shared Dash assessment preserves payment ordering and already-paid interval reuse. Retained controls show the original erroneous `Available`, corrected begin/resume denials after the172806 Start, and admission at the actual172810 expiry. I found no remaining concrete defect in these three C# changes.

**Correct the pending wire112 driver before running that qualification.** In [Test-Wire112Continuations.ps1](https://github.com/BordelonDevOps/DecenniumDescent/blob/7261052ae4dec908f8c0ac38e0a2c5f4b831065b/docs/unity/evidence/2026-11-16-tac03-declared-geometry-runtime/support/Test-Wire112Continuations.ps1#L16):

- Line16 reads an ignored local launch cache. Use the committed **`final/regression/launch.json`**.

The corrected locations contain the intended accepted evidence. This requires a fresh, bound execution of the affected compatibility driver. **It does not itself require changing C# binaries or restarting the current full regression.**

The host/driver binding mechanism addresses the previous code gap: applicable drivers record source lengths/hashes before execution and recheck afterward. Completed public campaign and compatibility bindings still belong in the final packet; I am not treating their pending executions as demonstrated.

My independent checks included:

- Both archive hashes/sizes and all **1,559 indexed members**.
- All **457 compilation-input hashes** and **955 static-input hashes** against the exact committed source.
- Focused report/build/DLL reconciliation, retained red reports and their original-runtime source inputs, corrected discovery/lock evidence, and focused before/after driver bindings.
- The superseded run’s **83 unique passing rows**, ordered assignment prefixes, six start/PID/stop records and absence of completion/DONE records.

I did **not** compile C#, execute gameplay or save restoration, run PowerShell qualification, or observe the new workers.

Full corrected five-path/public parity, authentic95–112 compatibility, trust/backup controls, the complete1576-case run and actual final review remain mandatory. No successor is authorized; Unity remains deferred and storage/Support held.
